comment: Source read at commit f6cf8d6, the commit whose plugin.json carries the installed 2.0.1. The counter limit parameter is configured with a default of 0 (ComparingCounter.cpp:53) although the panel letters the knob 1 and 31, and the A attenuator's default is 0 too, so a fresh module shows nothing at VALUE and nothing at A-B>T. The whole plugin is monophonic: no module in it calls getChannels, getPolyVoltage or setChannels. The VALUE output is given the cv family rather than pitch because it is a staircase count; the maker points out that its 0.166V step is a whole tone if it is used as a pitch.
